final_draft.content:
Dear Colleagues at the UK AI Safety Institute,

Thank you for the invitation to the reception celebrating the launch of your latest research findings on AI model evaluation and safety benchmarking. The Minister recognizes the exceptional importance of this work, which sits at the heart of his strategic priorities for AI safety and governance.

The Minister would be pleased to attend, though I should note he has a Cabinet committee commitment earlier that evening and would only be able to join from 7pm onwards. If this timing works for your event schedule, please confirm and we will ensure his attendance. Should this prove too late given the programme, we would be happy to arrange an alternative briefing session or send a senior representative from the Private Office.

Please let us know if attendance from 7pm would be suitable. The Minister looks forward to hearing about this groundbreaking research.

Office of Minister for Science, Innovation and Technology
final_draft.office_notes: Can only attend from 7pm onwards due to Cabinet committee
